query:
SELECT e.id,e.canonical_uri FROM discovery_entries e JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=e.source_id
        CROSS JOIN discovery_sources target WHERE target.id=$1 AND e.kind='post' AND e.state='active'
        AND e.verified_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '12 hours' AND (NOT $2 OR s.origin=target.origin)
        AND (NOT $3 OR e.actor_uri=$4) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_dismissals d WHERE d.entry_id=e.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_jobs j WHERE j.target_uri=e.canonical_uri AND (j.withdrawn OR j.leased_until>clock_timestamp()))
        ORDER BY e.verified_at,e.id LIMIT 1
